changes.reconciliation: read-only restart inspection of the current active quarantine state's incident ID and historical activation time against its deterministic immutable artifact and pressure-feed row
changes.artifact: descriptor-safe bounded read, strict duplicate-key JSON parsing, schema/identity/time checks, and exact canonical Incident serialization digest
changes.feed: bounded pressure-reader custody and semantics; exactly one matching identity, activation flag, time, artifact path, severity, mode, and triggers required for a complete local chain
changes.incomplete_or_conflicting: reported as incomplete/conflict with separate artifact/feed status; no records are repaired, synthesized, or replayed
changes.resident_index: forge index exposes quarantine_incident_custody without treating feed narrative as authenticated evidence

limitations: complete_local_custody is cross-record consistency, not independent publisher authentication.
The catalog entry is not included in this status; artifact/feed/catalog remain separate publications and can be interrupted between owners.
An active state with no matching artifact or feed is only labeled incomplete; no attack, intent, effect, or missing-record cause is inferred.
No production behavior or real defensive consequence is established.
